style: Dravidian temple complex with gopurams, vimanas and stone mandapams
key_structures: Four named gopurams on the walled enclosure
Gayatri Mandapam and the gilded Kamakshi sanctum vimana
Stepped pushkarini west of the temple block with a central festival pavilion
Vasantha, Shukrawara, Vahana and Navaratri Mandapams
special_features: Kamakshi seated in padmasana with four arms
Open routes around the walled complex for processions
Landscaped Nandavanam and granite seating documented in the restoration
materials: Carved granite pillars and hall structure
Gilding over the principal shrine vimana
Ivory stucco and stone gateway masonry
period: Later Pandya sanctum with later additions and modern restoration
renovation_history: The HUDCO conservation record describes restoration of the historic structure and visitor route, completed in 2018.
